title: Claude Code integrates four plugins to bypass token #claudecode #tokenlimitfix #aidevelopment
description: Claude Code introduced four plugins that overcome token limits and enhance AI coding workflows. OmniRoot provides access to over 200 free AI models to switch seamlessly when limits are reached, enabling practically unlimited tokens. Headroom compresses prompts to reduce token consumption, making large tasks more efficient. ClaudeMem offers long-term memory across sessions, eliminating the need to re-explain codebases repeatedly. Claude Code Setup analyzes your entire codebase and usage patterns, automatically creating AI tools for repetitive tasks and recommending the best MCPs and sub-agents for your workflow. These innovations significantly improve productivity and efficiency for developers relying on Claude Code. Comment "plugins" for the full setup guide including all four plugins. #ClaudeCode #OmniRoot #HeadroomPlugin #ClaudeMem #AIcoding #AIAutomation #DeveloperTools #AIplugins #CodeOptimization #LongTermMemory #AICodebase #ProductivityTools #AIworkflow #TechInnovation #CodingAssistant
